vehicle_name: Tesla Model Y Long Range AWD - Partially Sourced Reference

sourced_fields.drag_coefficient_cd: Cd 0.23, Wikipedia Tesla Model Y article
sourced_fields.rated_range_km_reference: 600 km WLTP for Long Range AWD (Juniper), Wikipedia Tesla Model Y article; a secondary source lists 586 km WLTP - cycle basis must be reconciled

assumptions: Usable energy fraction of 0.96 approximates the ~78/75 kWh nominal-to-usable ratio from secondary sources; not manufacturer-confirmed
Vehicle mass of 2100 kg is an inherited placeholder, not a verified kerb mass (Model Y L curb mass is reported at ~2088 kg; Long Range AWD mass must be sourced)
Frontal area is an unverified assumption
Rolling resistance and drivetrain efficiency are unverified assumptions
Regenerative braking parameters are unverified assumptions
Auxiliary load, HVAC load and rotational inertia factor are illustrative
provenance.note: For pipeline testing only. Tesla does not sell or certify the Model Y for the Indian market; the range reference is WLTP, not ARAI/MIDC. Do not present the calculated range as a validated real-world prediction.
